_comment: Copy to labels.json and edit. Keys are OpenRGB device names; inside, zone names map to a friendly label and _note is shown on the device card.

ASUS ROG STRIX X570-F GAMING._note: Aura USB controller. Mainboard zone LED 1 is the strip along the board edge; RGB Header 1-2 are the 12V headers.

HyperX Predator RGB._note: Kingston HyperX Fury RGB DDR4 kit (OpenRGB's label says Predator).

MSI GeForce GTX 1080 Gaming X._note: Custom OpenRGB driver (I2C 0x38). The MSI logo is full RGB; the underside accent LEDs are red-only and can only be switched on or off. The chip cannot be read back, so the shown colour is what was last sent.
